ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme and its connections to Minnesota nonprofit organizations.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail and investigate the connections between entities involved in the scheme.
questions: What were the methods used to commit fraud?
Who were the key players involved?
ideas.insight: The Feeding Our Future fraud scheme involves a significant amount of money and multiple entities.

ideas.title: Daycare Operator Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the daycare operator fraud schemes and their connections to pandemic meal programs.
ideas.angle: Investigate the methods used to commit fraud and the connections between entities involved.
questions: What were the methods used to commit fraud?
Who were the key players involved?
ideas.insight: Daycare operators have been involved in multiple fraud schemes, including pandemic meal program schemes.
